concept.description: External dependencies with normalized SCM URLs from their POM metadata, platform classification, and usage count.
concept.cypher: // Collect unique external dependencies with usage count MATCH (p:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_EFFECTIVE_MODEL]->(em) MATCH (em)-[:DECLARES_DEPENDENCY]->(d)-[:TO_ARTIFACT]->(a) MATCH (em)-[:HAS_SCM]->(scm) WHERE NOT p.version CONTAINS 'stub' AND NOT scm.url CONTAINS 'core-it-support' AND NOT a.version STARTS WITH '${' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.apache.maven' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.codehaus.plexus' AND NOT a.group STARTS WITH 'org.eclipse.sisu' WITH a.group AS depGroup, a.name AS depArtifact, collect(DISTINCT a.version) AS allVersions, count(DISTINCT p.groupId + ':' + p.artifactId) AS usedByProjects // Pick the latest (last) version to look up its POM SCM WITH depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions, usedByProjects, allVersions[-1] AS latestVersion // Look up SCM URL from the dependency's own POM in META-INF OPTIONAL MATCH (da:Maven:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(pom:Maven:Pom) -[:HAS_ROOT_ELEMENT]->(root:Xml:Element) -[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(scmEl:Xml:Element {name: 'scm'}) -[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(scmUrlEl:Xml:Element {name: 'url'}) -[:HAS_TEXT]->(scmText) WHERE pom.fileName STARTS WITH '/META-INF/' AND da.group = depGroup AND da.name = depArtifact WITH depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions, usedByProjects, collect(DISTINCT scmText.value) AS scmUrls // Fallback: look up project <url> element if no <scm> found OPTIONAL MATCH (da2:Maven:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(pom2:Maven:Pom) -[:HAS_ROOT_ELEMENT]->(root2:Xml:Element) -[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(projUrlEl:Xml:Element {name: 'url'}) -[:HAS_TEXT]->(projText) WHERE pom2.fileName STARTS WITH '/META-INF/' AND da2.group = depGroup AND da2.name = depArtifact AND NOT EXISTS { (root2)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(:Xml:Element {name: 'scm'}) } WITH depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions, usedByProjects, scmUrls, collect(DISTINCT projText.value) AS projectUrls // Pick SCM URL first, then fall back to project URL WITH depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions, usedByProjects, CASE WHEN size(scmUrls) > 0 THEN scmUrls[0] WHEN size(projectUrls) > 0 THEN projectUrls[0] ELSE 'n/a' END AS scmUrl, CASE WHEN size(scmUrls) > 0 THEN 'scm' WHEN size(projectUrls) > 0 THEN 'project-url' ELSE 'none' END AS urlSource // Normalize: http->https, gitbox->github, strip GitHub subpaths and /tree/... WITH depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions, usedByProjects, urlSource, CASE WHEN scmUrl STARTS WITH 'http://github.com' THEN replace(scmUrl, 'http://github.com', 'https://github.com') WHEN scmUrl STARTS WITH 'http://www.slf4j.org' THEN replace(scmUrl, 'http://', 'https://') WHEN scmUrl STARTS WITH 'http://www.eclipse.org' THEN replace(scmUrl, 'http://', 'https://') WHEN scmUrl STARTS WITH 'http://hc.apache.org' THEN replace(scmUrl, 'http://', 'https://') WHEN scmUrl STARTS WITH 'http://svn.apache.org' THEN replace(scmUrl, 'http://', 'https://') ELSE scmUrl END AS rawUrl WITH depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions, usedByProjects, urlSource, CASE // Apache Gitbox -> GitHub WHEN rawUrl =~ 'https?://(?:gitbox|git-wip-us)\\.apache\\.org/repos/asf.*' THEN 'https://github.com/apache/' + last(split(replace(replace(rawUrl, '?p=', '/'), '.git', ''), '/')) // Strip /tree/... tag paths WHEN rawUrl =~ 'https://github\\.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/tree/.*' THEN substring(rawUrl, 0, apoc.text.indexOf(rawUrl, '/tree/')) // Strip GitHub subpaths beyond owner/repo WHEN rawUrl =~ 'https://github\\.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/.+' THEN 'https://github.com/' + split(rawUrl, '/')[3] + '/' + split(rawUrl, '/')[4] ELSE rawUrl END AS scmUrl // Classify the hosting platform RETURN depGroup, depArtifact, allVersions AS versions, usedByProjects, scmUrl, urlSource, CASE WHEN scmUrl CONTAINS 'github.com' THEN 'GitHub' WHEN scmUrl CONTAINS 'gitlab' THEN 'GitLab' WHEN scmUrl CONTAINS 'bitbucket.org' THEN 'Bitbucket' WHEN scmUrl CONTAINS 'gitbox.apache.org' OR scmUrl CONTAINS 'git-wip-us.apache.org' THEN 'Apache Gitbox' WHEN scmUrl CONTAINS 'svn.apache.org' OR scmUrl CONTAINS 'svn.sourceforge.net' THEN 'SVN' WHEN scmUrl CONTAINS 'code.google.com' THEN 'Google Code' WHEN scmUrl = 'n/a' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'other' END AS platform ORDER BY platform, depGroup, depArtifact
